Borel covering majorants and isodiametry give the stated constant. Compact-fiber open-cover contents and the null-remainder argument supply the required a.e. measurability.

The prose now matches variation inside the frozen integrand. A0 correctly handles empty W and divides by positive finite volume otherwise. The mollification, compactness, mean-to-beta and cutoff arguments complete all three conjuncts.
The pinned weighted and multiplicity theorems have compatible types and standard axioms. The normDet/square-root Jacobian, dimension and fiber-sum identifications establish the exact frozen contract.

Properness gives the continuous chart inverse and local closedness; the curve argument proves both tangent inclusions. The projection formula proves continuity. The second conjunct's regularity hypothesis is included in IsSimonSubmanifold.

Chart area formulas, Gram determinant differentiation and uniform domination establish both exact derivative statements. Basis-independent expressions and compact support justify measurability and integrability.

The chart divergence argument and admissible smooth test deformations prove the variational equivalence. Within-derivative uniqueness on tangent directions justifies the frozen curvature definition; the normal-field identities complete stationary second variation.

Rank-determinant equivalence, coarea applied to the critical-set indicator, relative closedness and proper inverse-function slice charts prove every conjunct using the declared dependencies.
